item.title: LUPONERO Unleash Holiday Havoc with ‘Dad Bod Rok God (Merry Jinglebelly Version)’
item.description: Finnish hard-rock trio Luponero return once again to rework their underground hit DAD BOD ROK GOD — this time swapping sun-drenched swagger for full-blown festive chaos.
